name: Moha
storyline:
Curiosity is only the beginning.

A group of teenagers in Sri Lanka, driven by skepticism and fascination with the unknown, travels to a remote and forgotten village to investigate ancient exorcism rituals rooted in local folklore. What begins as an academic pursuit soon unravels into something far more terrifying.

The folklore was never just a story.

Deep within the rural landscapes of Sri Lanka, they uncover that the legend of the Mahasona and his army of demons is not myth, but an ancient evil that has awakened once again. Cut off from the outside world, they are forced into a desperate struggle to survive the nightmare they chose to uncover.

There is no escape from what has already been set in motion.

Moha is a first-person survival horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration, psychological tension, and narrative-driven gameplay. Players must uncover the truth behind the village, evade relentless supernatural threats, and endure an environment that grows increasingly hostile with every step forward.

Featuring immersive environments inspired by Sri Lankan rural landscapes, folklore-driven horror, and a focus on tension-based survival gameplay, Moha delivers a grounded yet supernatural horror experience rooted in regional myth.

Relive the nightmare buried beneath forgotten rituals.
summary: Curiosity leads a group of teenagers to a remote Sri Lankan village to investigate ancient exorcism rituals. When the local folklore proves horrifyingly real, their search for answers becomes a desperate fight to survive the wrath of the Mahasona and his army of demons.
